content: Google Play + YouTube policy risk: YouTube API Developer Policies prohibit API clients enabling downloads of YouTube content; YouTube ToS (June 2021) allows terminating users of download apps; YouTube publicly strengthening enforcement on third-party apps; real takedowns (Downloader app banned 2023, appeal rejected; apps removed citing YouTube API ToS). Play removed 2.36M policy-violating apps in 2024, 1.75M in 2025. Downloader category = persistent takedown/account-strike risk.
